about.title: About STRAM PESO
about.subtitle: A province-wide employment portal for Marinduque.
about.body: STRAM PESO connects jobseekers, employers, and the six municipalities of Marinduque, built on the province's Labor Market Data and the work of the Public Employment Service Office. It was designed and built as a 4th-year capstone project by students of Marinduque State University — College of Information and Computing Sciences.

danger.title: Account Deactivation
danger.subtitle: Temporarily remove your account from STRAM PESO.
danger.body: Deactivating hides your profile and listings and signs you out. This is reversible — sign in again with your password at any time to reactivate your account.
danger.confirmMessage: Your profile will be hidden and you'll be signed out. Sign back in with your password anytime to reactivate it.
danger.deactivateSuccess: Your account has been deactivated. Sign in again anytime to reactivate it.
danger.deactivateError: Couldn't deactivate your account. Please try again.

nsrpTemplates.title: Settings: Printed NSRP Forms
nsrpTemplates.subtitle: Upload and align the printed National Skills Registration Program PDF templates.
nsrpTemplates.warning: Field positions are not automatically remapped. After replacing a template, inspect every page of the filled sample and verify alignment before using it in production. Matching page dimensions does not guarantee matching layout.
nsrpTemplates.requirements: PDF only, up to 5 MB. Page count, dimensions and rotation must match the original form. Each form is replaced independently.
nsrpTemplates.dropHintPrefix: Drag & drop your PDF template here, or
nsrpTemplates.form1Hint: Page count & rotation must match the original NSRP Form 1.
nsrpTemplates.form2Hint: Page count & rotation must match the original NSRP Form 2.
nsrpTemplates.upload: Replace template and download filled sample

staffRecovery.title: Request PESO account recovery
staffRecovery.policy: Online recovery is for jobseekers only. Employer and staff accounts require in-person verification at the PESO counter.
staffRecovery.requestLink: No backup code? Request a PESO staff review
staffRecovery.notificationHint: Contact-verified account recovery requests awaiting staff review.
staffRecovery.filesHint: Upload your ID and a clear selfie. Maximum 5 MB each. Files are private and removed 90 days after the request is resolved. OCR reads text; staff make the decision.
staffRecovery.received: If this account exists, your request has been received. Check your contact inbox to confirm that address, then wait for PESO staff. You can submit again if a recovery link expires.
staffRecovery.contactConfirmed: If the link was valid, your contact email is confirmed. PESO staff will review your request.
staffRecovery.finishHint: Set a new password. Opening this recovery link and completing this form confirms your contact email as your new sign-in address.
staffRecovery.finished: Your password and sign-in email are updated. Sign in using your new details.
staffRecovery.error: Could not complete this action. Check your details and link, then try again. If necessary, contact the PESO office.
staffRecovery.reviewHint: Compare the submitted ID and selfie against the ID already on file and the account history. Reject if you cannot establish ownership, and direct the requester to the PESO counter. OCR never approves an identity.
staffRecovery.noAccount: No matching account. Online recovery cannot be approved.
staffRecovery.reason: Review evidence and decision reason (at least 10 characters)
staffRecovery.identityMatched: I compared both IDs and the selfie and established account ownership.
staffRecovery.previewHint: Use the document link to open a PDF or retry the image.
